newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Excel Machine gets approval for Singapore listing.
newsitem.headline: Excel Machine gets approval for Singapore listing.

text.p: Singapore-based Excel Machine Tools said on Wednesday it received in-principle approval to list on the mainboard of the Stock Exchange of Singapore.
It said in a statement that Excel posted a net profit of Singapore $5.1 million last year, more than three times the S$1.6 million recorded in 1992.
The group's turnover over the last five years has grown at an annual compounded rate of 30 percent to about S$53 million in 1996.
Established in 1986, the company designs, manufactures, and markets machine tools.
Overseas Union Bank will manage Exel's initial public offering of shares, it said.
The group operates eight subsidiaries in five countries, including Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Hungary, and the United States.
Asia consumes 36 percent of the world's output of machine tools, with the market projected to grow at an average rate of 10 percent in the next four years, it said.
